_comment: Sterling Axiom マスコット事前生成ライブラリ:生成パターン定義。base に共通の外見指定、patterns に個別の表情・ポーズ。framing=bust は下半身を描かせないため『4本足になる』『脚が変な場所から生える』破綻が原理的に起きない。迷ったら bust を選ぶこと。

base.positive: chibi anthropomorphic brown miniature dachshund character, standing upright on two legs like a human, round chubby cute body proportions, big friendly eyes, wearing a navy blue business suit vest, flat vector illustration style, clean simple solid white background, centered composition, no text, no letters, no watermark
base.negative: text, letters, words, watermark, signature, realistic dog, four-legged, quadruped, on all fours, extra limbs, extra arms, extra legs, deformed hands, malformed fingers, distorted face, blurry, cluttered background
